inputs.text: John Lahart, a Fianna Fáil TD for Dublin South-West, has called for reform of inheritance tax exemption thresholds, describing the current system as ‘wholly unfair’ and discriminatory against those without children. This follows recent contributions from party colleagues on reviewing how the tax applies across different family structures. This exposes the systemic discrimination baked into our institutions, where policies have long favored traditional family models and reinforced historical inequalities that disadvantage vulnerable groups who don't have children. Real institutional reform is needed to dismantle these biases and advance social justice and equality for everyone.

output.main_topic: Calls to reform inheritance tax exemption thresholds over concerns about discrimination against people without children
